description:
Get the price range for a WEE WiLDS unit.

    Returns a static min/max GBP range. Dynamic per-night quotes are not yet
    available — for an exact quote, use send_inquiry.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
        check_in: Ignored for now (kept for forward-compat with dynamic pricing).
        check_out: Ignored for now (kept for forward-compat with dynamic pricing).

check_in.description: Optional arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Not used yet: the range is the same for any dates.
check_in.title: Check In

check_out.description: Optional departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Not used yet: the range is the same for any dates.
check_out.title: Check Out

unit.description: Which WEE WiLDS unit: "muckle-meadow-pod" (Muckle Meadow Glamping Pod), "cosie-coorie-pod" (Cosy Coorie Pod) or "bb" (the B&B, all 4 rooms).
unit.title: Unit

name: get_pricing
title: Get price range
